items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Adds the missing unit + E2E coverage and the header doc for the HTML stylesheet inlining and pop-out shipped in #551; no new behaviour.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Covered by test: unreadable stylesheet falls back to the raw html; inlining never throws into the render path.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No production code change; sandbox and CSP untouched; tests assert a </style breakout stays escaped and traversal hrefs clamp to the project root.

items.note: Behaviour asserted via srcdoc content, rendered computed colour in real Chromium (inline + modal), and stale-result handling on path change.

items.note: Existing spec/test files extended; header comment re-wrapped under 80 cols; files under 300 lines.
